summary: Implemented and validated Python executor window support, including planner Window step, window aggregates/ranking/navigation, frames (ROWS/RANGE/GROUPS), exclusions, IGNORE NULLS, QUALIFY, named windows, grouped windows, and efficient large-frame evaluation. Ran compile checks and targeted end-to-end/50k-row smoke tests.
